name: Ephoto DAM Field
description: Provides an Ephoto Dam field type that stores an Ephoto asset URL (plus metadata) on an entity and outputs a preview/embed on display.
project_description: Ephoto DAM Field is a submodule of the Ephoto Dam project. It adds a field type that stores the URL (and metadata: identifier, size, version, caption, thumbnail) of an asset chosen from the Ephoto digital-asset-management library, with a widget that opens the Ephoto chooser and a formatter that renders a preview. Use it to attach Ephoto-hosted assets to entities as structured field data instead of embedding them inline through CKEditor 5.
